title: US Employers Shed Jobs, Unemployment Falls
title_cn: 美国雇主裁员，失业率下降
summary: Friday's weaker-than-expected jobs report for July sent stocks up, on skepticisms that the Fed would cut interest rate amid a softening labor market. Bloomberg's Mike McKee and Deutsche Bank Chief US Economist Matthew Luzzetti discuss the latest report. The pair also react to US Director of the National Economic Council telling Bloomberg News that the President and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh talk "all the time." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Weak Jobs Report Fuels Rate Hike Skeptics | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/7/2026
title_cn: 就业报告疲弱加剧加息怀疑论者彭博商业周刊日报 8/7/2026
summary: A weaker-than-expected jobs report has stock rebounding on speculation the Fed may not have to hike rates soon. Plus, Indeed Hiring Lab Director of Economic Research Laura Ullrich talks about the impact to jobs in the education sector and what she's seeing as the fasted growing jobs in the US. summary: Dozens of people who were charged or convicted in connection with the violent riots at the US Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, have filed lawsuits seeking millions of dollars from the US government after the Trump administration walked back the sprawling prosecution effort.
